facts.fact: The PAGDS project's explainer says the SGCH hospital information system traces the patient from entry to discharge, digitises the medical record and gives each patient a unique identifier under which the patient is handled at any health centre in the country that has the solution, staff reaching it through a web platform in the health centres; the page is undated and the date is its published date, a proxy.
facts.system: SGCH (Système de Gestion de Centre Hospitalier)

facts.fact: The PAGDS project's explainer states that SGCH, a hospital information system holding the digitised patient medical record, was designed by the Ministry of Health, Public Hygiene and Universal Health Coverage; it names no financier and no plan, and the page is undated, so the date is its published date, a proxy.
facts.system: SGCH (Système de Gestion de Centre Hospitalier)

systems.system: SGCH (Système de Gestion de Centre Hospitalier)
systems.owner: Ministry of health (MSHPCMU), which designed it
systems.tiers: health establishments where the solution is deployed; no count and no tier stated; modules cover admissions and medical records, pharmacy, beds, hospitalisation, insurance and tariffs, finance and accounting, blood bank, emergencies, pathologies, births and deaths, and the monthly SIG reports

systems.platform: mobile application on AppStore and PlayStore
systems.tiers: patients, who open their patient record, book appointments and pay at any health centre where the SIH is deployed
